title: Manifest
description: A project's table of contents and settings: its title, system, theme, the ordered list of chapters and the cover. The order of `chapters` is the order of the book. In a .rosetta file this is manifest.json.

rosettaVersion.description: Spec version the project was written for, for example 0.1.

system.description: Name of the game-system plugin, such as example.

theme.description: Name of the theme, such as classic.

title.description: Text on the cover when it differs from the book's title.

chapters.description: In book order. Ids are unique within the project (not expressible here; validateManifest checks it).
